body:
**Source:** the owner's ticketing standard (2026-09-28), story S13







Classify one issue (from `gh issue view --json`) into the six dimensions, flags and triage state, printing the rule behind each value.







**Acceptance:**



- `trellis ticket triage <n>` prints each label with the rule that set it



- An abstaining rule prints its reason



- Tested against recorded issue JSON

## Decision
Yes: `triage <n>` is read-only; `sweep` is the only command that writes labels. Waits on #75 and #76 (blocked_by).

Decided 2026-09-28 by the owner, via the coordinator.

## Done when
- `trellis-tickets triage <n>` prints one line per dimension with the rule that set it or the abstention's reason; `--json` emits one object.
- It never writes to GitHub.
- Three tests named `triage_*` over recorded issue JSON fixtures, with `gh` never spawned.

## Verify
```
scripts/tickets/verify-tests.sh trellis-tickets triage_ 3
```

Pre-check on drain 50b3295: exit 1

<!-- triage:start (generated; do not hand-edit) -->

## Tasks

- [ ] Fetch issue JSON through gh
- [ ] Run the rule engine
- [ ] Print labels with their rule
- [ ] Test against recorded JSON fixtures

## Triage

```yaml
story: S13
labels: [area:cli, kind:feature, risk:medium, surface:cli, effort:m, origin:manual]
flags: [!agent-ok]
triage: blocked
triage_reasons: ["depends on open #75"]
ready: false
ready_failures: ["blocked by #75 (OPEN)"]
blocked_by: [75, 76]
triaged_at: 2026-09-28T21:13:17Z
triage_version: 2
```

<!-- triage:end -->

labels.name: !agent-ok
labels.description: An agent may execute this unsupervised (all six rules hold)

labels.name: triage:auto
labels.description: No triage v2 rule routes it to a human and nothing blocks it

labels.name: type:ticket
labels.description: One ticket; tasks are its checklist

title: Add trellis ticket triage
